newsitem.title: USA: U.S high-yield debt deals postponed as prices drop.
newsitem.headline: U.S high-yield debt deals postponed as prices drop.

text.p: At least two high-yield debt offerings were postponed on Friday as investors watched prices deteriorate ahead of a possible rise in interest rates, syndicate officials said.

Qwest Communications International Inc's planned $450 million deal, which includes a $250 million zero-coupon tranche, was made next week's business in light of market conditions, said a source close to the deal. The issue is also expected to include $200 million 10-year senior notes.
Salomon Brothers is lead manager on the deal.
